title: Token-adaptive quant kernel allocator and prefill hedging
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Problem: Switching between quantized (INT8/FP8) execution and higher-precision paths introduces dequantization overhead and memory thrash during mixed prefill/decode workloads, degrading tail latency. Goal: Implement a token-adaptive kernel allocator that maintains lightweight precision-specific kernel pools, makes per-token kernel choices at dispatch time, and supports a hedging prefill strategy that opportunistically routes early tokens to low-latency quant fastpaths while falling back gracefully for precision-sensitive tokens. Scope includes runtime allocator API, kernel pool lifecycle, migration heuristics, telemetry, and A/B rollout knobs. This ticket focuses on the allocator and scheduling strategy; separate follow-ups will add model-specific quant profiles and cross-model routing policies.

acceptance_criteria: Allocator design document approved by runtime and infra leads
KernelPoolManager implemented with create/evict/migrate APIs and covered by unit tests
TokenAdvisor provides per-token precision hints and is pluggable per model route
Hedging prefill policy implemented and configurable per-route (off/hedge/safe-mode)
Benchmarks: p99 latency improvement >= 3% on representative chat workloads and median token cost reduction >= 3% versus baseline for INT8-enabled models
No KV-cache corruption or race conditions in stress tests; KV shard migration covered by integration tests
Telemetry emitted for kernel-switch counts, hedged prefill events, and per-request precision path chosen; dashboards updated
Canary rollout path defined with automatic rollback criteria documented
implementation_notes:
High-level approach:
- KernelPoolManager: maintain small pools keyed by (precision, kernel-flavor, head-group). Pools pre-warm common kernel variants to avoid JIT/compile stalls.
- TokenAdvisor: lightweight scorer using token position, recent softmax variance, and spare KV capacity to prefer quant fastpath when confidence threshold met.
- Hedging prefill: dispatch first N tokens to quant fastpath with a short timeout; if precision-sensitive signals appear or dequant time exceeds threshold, dispatch fallback decode on a high-precision kernel and merge streams using deterministic merge point.
- KV migration: perform copy-on-write shadowing for in-flight shards, promote after consistent checkpoint to avoid races.
- Rollout: gated per-model with feature flag, telemetry gates for p99/regression, automatic rollback on QoS violations.
Bench plan: microbench isolation, synthetic chat replay, and production shadow run behind traffic mirror for two weeks. Metric targets: p99 latency, cost per 1M tokens, kernel-switch rate.
